hero.headline: Games & Activities
hero.tagline: Play your way to brilliance! Choose a game and start the fun.

games.title: Number Pop!
games.subject: maths
games.description: Pop the balloons with the right answers before they float away! Great for counting and quick maths.

games.title: Times Table Race
games.subject: maths
games.description: Race against the clock to answer times table questions. The faster you answer, the faster your car goes!

games.title: Fraction Pizza
games.subject: maths
games.description: Slice the pizza into the right fractions and serve your customers before they get hungry!

games.title: Shape Sorter
games.subject: maths
games.description: Sort 2D and 3D shapes into the right boxes before the conveyor belt runs out of space!

games.title: Number Bonds
games.subject: maths
games.description: Learn number bonds to 10 and 20 with colourful snap blocks! See the numbers visually and find the missing piece.

games.title: Punctuation Patrol
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Spot the missing punctuation and fix the sentence! Full stops, commas, apostrophes, question marks and more.

games.title: Animal Habitats
games.subject: science
games.description: Match each animal to its correct habitat! From Arctic tundra to coral reefs — learn where animals live and why.

games.title: Times Tables Challenge
games.subject: maths
games.description: Rapid-fire times table quiz! Beat the clock and earn speed bonuses for lightning-fast answers.

games.title: Sentence Scramble
games.subject: reading
games.description: Put the jumbled words back in the right order to make a proper sentence. Tap words to build your answer!

games.title: Science Lab
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore cause and effect in science! Answer questions about plants, space, materials, the human body and more.

games.title: Word Scramble
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Unscramble jumbled letters to spell the correct word! Tap the tiles to build your answer.

games.title: Word Wizard
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Cast spelling spells by unscrambling letters to form the correct word. Each correct spell earns you a star!

games.title: Spelling Bee
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Listen to the word, then type it correctly to help the bee collect honey. Tap the speaker to hear it again!

games.title: Tricky Word Hunt
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Find the tricky words hidden in the picture. Tap each one to hear it read aloud and spell it out!

games.title: Story Builder
games.subject: stories
games.description: Choose your character, setting, and adventure — then read the story that unfolds! Tap any word to hear it read aloud.

games.title: Phonics Parrot
games.subject: reading
games.description: Help Pip the Parrot learn new sounds! Tap the letters to hear their sounds and build words together.

games.title: Reading Quest
games.subject: reading
games.description: Go on a reading adventure! Read the passage, answer questions, and unlock the next chapter of the story.

games.title: Word Search
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Find hidden words in the grid! Click letters to spell out animals, colours or numbers hidden in every direction.

games.title: Crossword
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Read the clues and fill in the crossword grid! Original puzzles on animals, colours and numbers.

games.title: Number Sudoku
games.subject: maths
games.description: Fill the 4×4 grid so every row, column and 2×2 box contains 1, 2, 3 and 4. A brilliant logic puzzle for young mathematicians!

games.title: Colour-In Book
games.subject: art
games.description: Pick a colour and tap the picture to colour it in! Houses, butterflies, rockets and fish — all waiting for your colours!

games.title: Alphabet Explorer
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Explore every letter A to Z — see the picture, hear the sound, learn the word. Then take the quiz to earn your stars!

games.title: Times Tables Reader
games.subject: maths
games.description: Browse all 12 times tables, tap any fact to hear it read aloud, then test yourself with a quick quiz. Great for all ages!

games.title: Sentence Builder
games.subject: reading
games.description: Tap the word tiles to put them in the right order and build a proper sentence. Easy, medium and hard levels!

games.title: Animal Kingdom
games.subject: science
games.description: Test your animal knowledge! From habitats to food chains, explore the animal kingdom in this fun science quiz.

games.title: Nature Explorer
games.subject: science
games.description: Match plants to their habitats, discover life cycles, and explore ecosystems in this nature science game.

games.title: Geography Quiz
games.subject: science
games.description: How well do you know the world? Test your knowledge of capitals, countries, flags and landmarks!

games.title: Mental Maths Sprint
games.subject: maths
games.description: Race the clock! Answer rapid-fire sums as fast as you can. How many can you get right before time runs out?

games.title: Colour & Learn
games.subject: art
games.description: Pick a colour and tap the matching number to fill in the picture. A fun creative activity that teaches colours and number recognition!

games.title: Number Grid
games.subject: maths
games.description: Fill the number grid using logic and deduction. A brilliant puzzle that sharpens number skills and problem-solving for all ages!

games.title: Maths Bingo
games.subject: maths
games.description: Mark off the answers on your bingo card as the sums are called out. First to shout BINGO wins!

games.title: Coin Counter
games.subject: maths
games.description: Count the coins and find the right total. Learn about UK money with pennies, 5p, 10p, 20p and 50p coins!

games.title: Odd or Even?
games.subject: maths
games.description: Sort the numbers into odd and even buckets before the timer runs out. How fast can you sort them all?

games.title: UK Geography
games.subject: science
games.description: Learn about UK countries, capitals, flags and landmarks! From Big Ben to Ben Nevis.

games.title: Synonyms & Antonyms
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Match words with the same or opposite meanings! Build your vocabulary from easy to tricky.

games.title: Place Value Pop
games.subject: maths
games.description: Pop the balloon that shows the correct hundreds, tens or units digit. Master place value with this fun game!

games.title: Multiplication Grid
games.subject: maths
games.description: Fill in the missing products on the multiplication grid. A great way to practise all your times tables at once!

games.title: Division Dash
games.subject: maths
games.description: Divide the numbers as fast as you can! Three difficulty levels from simple halving to long division.

games.title: Number Line Jump
games.subject: maths
games.description: Jump to the right position on the number line! Estimate and place numbers from 0–100 and 0–1000.

games.title: Maths Mystery
games.subject: maths
games.description: Solve the clues using maths to crack the mystery! Each correct answer reveals part of the hidden picture.

games.title: Pattern Maker
games.subject: maths
games.description: Spot the pattern and choose what comes next! Colour patterns, shape patterns and number sequences.

games.title: Angle Explorer
games.subject: maths
games.description: Identify acute, obtuse and right angles hidden in shapes and real-world objects. Become an angle expert!

games.title: Perimeter Quest
games.subject: maths
games.description: Calculate the perimeter of shapes to build fences around the farm. Add up all the sides correctly!

games.title: Area Adventure
games.subject: maths
games.description: Count the squares to find the area of each shape. Then use the formula to calculate bigger areas!

games.title: Data Detective
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read bar charts, pictograms and tally charts to answer questions. Become a data detective!

games.title: Fraction Match
games.subject: maths
games.description: Match equivalent fractions, decimals and percentages. Flip the cards to find the matching pairs!

games.title: Speed Tables
games.subject: maths
games.description: Answer as many times table questions as possible in 60 seconds. Beat your personal best each time!

games.title: Rounding Rocket
games.subject: maths
games.description: Round numbers to the nearest 10, 100 or 1000 to fuel the rocket. The more accurate you are, the higher it flies!

games.title: Negative Numbers
games.subject: maths
games.description: Order temperatures on a thermometer and solve problems with negative numbers. Perfect for ages 10+!

games.title: Coordinates Grid
games.subject: maths
games.description: Plot and read coordinates in all four quadrants. Find the treasure by following the coordinate clues!

games.title: Symmetry Studio
games.subject: maths
games.description: Complete the symmetrical pattern by reflecting shapes across the mirror line. Create beautiful symmetrical art!

games.title: Time Teller
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read analogue and digital clocks, calculate time differences and solve time word problems!

games.title: Word Problem Wizard
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read the story and solve the maths problem hidden inside. Real-world maths made fun!

games.title: Ordering Numbers
games.subject: maths
games.description: Drag the numbers into the correct order from smallest to largest. Whole numbers, decimals and fractions!

games.title: Missing Numbers
games.subject: maths
games.description: Find the missing number in each equation. Inverse operations, algebra basics and number puzzles!

games.title: Maths Snap
games.subject: maths
games.description: Snap when two cards show the same answer! Quick mental maths in a classic card game format.

games.title: Ratio Recipe
games.subject: maths
games.description: Scale up the recipe using ratios and proportions. How much flour do you need for 12 cakes instead of 4?

games.title: Prime Number Hunt
games.subject: maths
games.description: Identify prime numbers on the grid and cross out the composites. Can you find all the primes up to 100?

games.title: Algebra Quest
games.subject: maths
games.description: Solve for x in simple equations and inequalities. An adventure through the world of algebra!

games.title: Maths Challenge
games.subject: maths
games.description: A mixed bag of maths questions across all topics. The ultimate maths challenge for top mathematicians!

games.title: Letter Sounds
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Tap the letter to hear its sound, then find the picture that starts with that sound. Great for early readers!

games.title: Rhyme Time
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Find the word that rhymes! Listen to the word and pick the matching rhyme from the options.

games.title: Syllable Split
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Clap out the syllables and choose the right number. Helps children break words into manageable chunks!

games.title: Prefix Power
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Add the right prefix to make a new word. Un-, re-, pre-, mis- and more — unlock the power of prefixes!

games.title: Suffix Quest
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Choose the correct suffix to complete the word. -ing, -ed, -er, -est, -tion and more!

games.title: Homophones Hunt
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Choose the correct spelling — there/their/they're, to/too/two, your/you're and more tricky homophones!

games.title: Compound Words
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Join two words together to make a compound word! Sunshine, football, rainbow — how many can you make?

games.title: Spelling Challenge
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Spell the word correctly after hearing it read aloud. Progressively harder words across three difficulty levels!

games.title: Word Families
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Group words that belong to the same family — cat, bat, hat, mat. Build word family trees!

games.title: Missing Letters
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Fill in the missing letters to complete the word. The picture gives you a clue — can you spell it?

games.title: Anagram Attack
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Unscramble the jumbled letters to find the hidden word before the timer runs out!

games.title: Silent Letters
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Identify the silent letter in each word — knight, wrap, gnome. Master these tricky spelling patterns!

games.title: Double Letters
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Decide if the word needs a double letter or not — rabbit or rabit? Butter or buter? Spell it right!

games.title: Vowel Sounds
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Sort words by their vowel sound — long a, short a, oo, ow and more. A fun phonics sorting game!

games.title: Spelling Snap
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Snap when you see a correctly spelled word! Quick-fire spelling in a classic card game format.

games.title: Word Builder
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Use the letter tiles to build as many words as possible. Score points for longer words!

games.title: Dictionary Dash
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Put the words in alphabetical order before the time runs out. Race to the top of the dictionary!

games.title: Contraction Station
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Match the contraction to the two words it comes from — can't = can not, I'm = I am. All aboard!

games.title: Plural Rules
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Make the word plural using the right rule — add s, es, ies or change the word entirely!

games.title: Word Match
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Match the word to its picture in this memory card game. Flip, remember and match!

games.title: Spelling Race
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Race against the clock to spell as many words correctly as possible. Can you beat your high score?

games.title: Comprehension Quest
games.subject: reading
games.description: Read the passage and answer questions about what you've read. Build your comprehension skills step by step!

games.title: Story Sequence
games.subject: reading
games.description: Put the story pictures in the right order to retell the tale. What happened first, next and last?

games.title: Reading Detective
games.subject: reading
games.description: Find the clues in the text to answer the detective questions. Inference and deduction skills!

games.title: Grammar Garage
games.subject: reading
games.description: Fix the broken sentences in the grammar garage! Nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs all need sorting.

games.title: Noun Spotter
games.subject: reading
games.description: Spot all the nouns in the sentence and tap them! Common nouns, proper nouns and collective nouns.

games.title: Verb Volcano
games.subject: reading
games.description: Throw the verbs into the volcano before it erupts! Identify action words and tense changes.

games.title: Adjective Adventure
games.subject: reading
games.description: Describe the pictures using adjectives! Colour, size, shape and feeling words to bring stories to life.

games.title: Synonym Swap
games.subject: reading
games.description: Swap the word for a synonym that means the same thing. Expand your vocabulary with this word swap game!

games.title: Antonym Arena
games.subject: reading
games.description: Battle the antonyms! Match each word with its opposite in this fast-paced word game.

games.title: Speed Reader
games.subject: reading
games.description: Read the passage as fast as you can, then answer questions to check you understood it. Build reading fluency!

games.title: Poetry Corner
games.subject: reading
games.description: Read the poem and answer questions about rhyme, rhythm and meaning. Explore different types of poetry!

games.title: Text Types
games.subject: reading
games.description: Identify the text type — is it a letter, a recipe, a newspaper article or a story? Sort them correctly!

games.title: Reading Map
games.subject: reading
games.description: Follow the reading map through a non-fiction text. Answer questions at each checkpoint to move forward!

games.title: Word Meaning
games.subject: reading
games.description: Use the context clues in the sentence to work out what the tricky word means. Vocabulary in context!

games.title: Speech Marks
games.subject: reading
games.description: Add the speech marks in the right places. Who is saying what? Direct speech made easy!

games.title: Connectives Bridge
games.subject: reading
games.description: Choose the right connective to join the sentences — because, however, although, therefore and more!

games.title: Reading Fluency
games.subject: reading
games.description: Read the passage aloud at the right pace. Tap the words as you read to build fluency and confidence!

games.title: Book Review
games.subject: reading
games.description: Read a short extract and write a mini book review. What did you like? Who would you recommend it to?

games.title: Reading Bingo
games.subject: reading
games.description: Mark off the reading features on your bingo card as you spot them in the text. First to BINGO wins!

games.title: Story Map
games.subject: reading
games.description: Map out the beginning, middle and end of the story. Identify characters, setting and plot!

games.title: Reading Challenge
games.subject: reading
games.description: The ultimate reading challenge! Mixed comprehension, grammar and vocabulary questions across all levels.

games.title: Money Maths
games.subject: maths
games.description: Count UK coins and notes, make change, and solve money problems! From 1p coins to £20 notes.

games.title: Parts of Speech
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Identify nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs in real sentences! Build your grammar knowledge.

games.title: Telling the Time
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read analogue and digital clocks! O'clock, half past, quarter past, quarter to and 5-minute intervals.

games.title: Human Body
games.subject: science
games.description: Label the parts of the human body and learn what each organ does. From bones to the brain!

games.title: Solar System
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore the planets of our solar system! Order them from the Sun and learn amazing facts about each one.

games.title: Food Chains
games.subject: science
games.description: Build food chains by connecting producers, consumers and predators. Who eats who in the wild?

games.title: States of Matter
games.subject: science
games.description: Sort materials into solid, liquid and gas. Then explore what happens when they change state!

games.title: Forces Lab
games.subject: science
games.description: Investigate push, pull, gravity and friction in the virtual forces lab. Predict and test!

games.title: Electricity Circuit
games.subject: science
games.description: Build a working circuit! Connect the battery, bulb and switch to light up the room.

games.title: Plant Parts
games.subject: science
games.description: Label the parts of a plant and learn what each part does. Roots, stem, leaves, flower and seed!

games.title: Life Cycles
games.subject: science
games.description: Put the life cycle stages in the right order — butterfly, frog, plant and human life cycles!

games.title: Weather Watch
games.subject: science
games.description: Identify weather types, read weather maps and predict tomorrow's weather. Become a meteorologist!

games.title: Rock Detective
games.subject: science
games.description: Identify igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks. Use the clues to classify each rock sample!

games.title: Light and Shadows
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore how light travels and creates shadows. Predict shadow shapes and learn about reflection!

games.title: Sound Science
games.subject: science
games.description: Investigate how sound travels, what makes sounds louder and how we hear. A sonic science adventure!

games.title: Materials Sort
games.subject: science
games.description: Sort materials by their properties — hard or soft, magnetic or not, transparent or opaque!

games.title: Skeleton Builder
games.subject: science
games.description: Drag the bones into the right place to build a human skeleton. Learn the names of major bones!

games.title: Healthy Eating
games.subject: science
games.description: Sort foods into the right food groups and build a balanced meal. Learn about nutrition and healthy choices!

games.title: Microhabitats
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore minibeasts and their microhabitats. Where does each creature live and why?

games.title: Magnets Magic
games.subject: science
games.description: Test which materials are magnetic and which are not. Explore north and south poles and magnetic fields!

games.title: Water Cycle
games.subject: science
games.description: Follow a water droplet through evaporation, condensation and precipitation. Label the water cycle!

games.title: Classification Keys
games.subject: science
games.description: Use branching keys to classify animals and plants. Answer yes/no questions to identify each organism!

games.title: Earth and Space
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore the Earth, Moon and Sun system. Day and night, seasons and the phases of the Moon!

games.title: Evolution Explorer
games.subject: science
games.description: Explore adaptation and evolution. How do animals change over time to survive in their environment?

games.title: Science Quiz
games.subject: science
games.description: The ultimate science quiz! Questions across biology, chemistry, physics and earth science for all levels.

games.title: Football Times Tables
games.subject: maths
games.description: Answer a times-table question, choose where to aim, then take your shot and earn action points.

games.title: Basketball Grammar
games.subject: reading
games.description: Solve a grammar question to unlock a basketball shot from your chosen position.

games.title: Netball Spelling
games.subject: spelling
games.description: Choose the correct spelling, step into the shooting circle and aim for a netball goal.

games.title: Pool Science
games.subject: science
games.description: Answer a science question to earn one pool shot, then choose the pocket you want to aim for.

games.title: Shopkeeper Change
games.subject: maths
games.description: Run a pretend shop, calculate change in UK money and serve each customer carefully.

games.title: Clock Quest
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read clock clues, choose the digital time and help Archie arrive on time.

games.title: Train Timetable
games.subject: maths
games.description: Read departure and arrival times, calculate journey lengths and complete safe railway tasks.

games.title: Clinic Science
games.subject: science
games.description: Learn safe body and health facts while helping kindly at Archie’s pretend clinic.

readAloudBanner.headline: Every game talks to you!
readAloudBanner.description: Tap the 🔊 speaker on any game card to hear the instructions read aloud. Perfect for children who are still building their reading confidence.

weeklyChallenge.title: Mental Maths Sprint
weeklyChallenge.tagline: This week's challenge — race the clock and beat your best score!
weeklyChallenge.prize: Earn a special Weekly Champion badge for 3 stars ⭐⭐⭐
